Admin._comment: Only these emails may sign in. Empty = no one (fail closed). SuperAdminEmails additionally see cross-tenant pages.

Dashboard._comment: Public base URL of the redirect site, used to render full short URLs. Empty = show the bare code.

CustomDomain._comment: DNS-TXT verification: users create a TXT record at <VerificationHostLabel>.<domain> with value <TxtValuePrefix><token>.

Email._comment: Mode: Resend (send all via Resend) | Log (dev: log every email) | Hybrid (Resend for DeliverableDomains, log the rest). Set Mode=Hybrid + DeliverableDomains in appsettings.Development.json/user-secrets to grab magic links for non-deliverable test addresses from the console.

Resend._comment: ApiKey comes from user-secrets (Resend:ApiKey). FromAddress must be a Resend-verified domain in prod; onboarding@resend.dev delivers only to your own account email for local testing.

Sentry._comment: Error tracking, opt-in — unset means exactly today's behavior (no outbound telemetry at all). Dsn is a secret; set it via user-secrets/Railway env (Sentry:Dsn). Get one from sentry.io (free tier).

Axiom._comment: Structured log shipping, opt-in — unset means logs stay console-only, exactly today's behavior. ApiToken is a secret; set both via user-secrets/Railway env (Axiom:ApiToken/Axiom:Dataset). Dataset is the Axiom dataset name to ingest into (axiom.co, free tier).

Threads._comment: The Threads-specific app ID/secret from developers.facebook.com (App Settings → Basic → 'Threads app ID'/'Threads app secret' — a separate credential pair from the app-level App ID/Secret shown above them on the same page; a future Facebook/Instagram connector would get its own section here instead of reusing this one). AppSecret comes from user-secrets/Railway env (Threads:AppSecret) — never commit it. No RedirectUri here: the OAuth authorize/callback endpoints (and the only place that value matters) are Core's SocialOAuthController now — Admin only needs AppId/AppSecret, to sign its own publish/metrics calls with appsecret_proof.

Reddit._comment: Reddit app credentials from reddit.com/prefs/apps (type: web app) — see docs/REDDIT_APP_SETUP.md. AppSecret comes from user-secrets/Railway env (Reddit:AppSecret) — never commit it. No RedirectUri here: the OAuth authorize/callback endpoints are Core's SocialOAuthController now — Admin only needs AppId/AppSecret, for token refresh during its own publish/metrics calls. UserAgent must stay descriptive per Reddit's API rules.

CoreApi._comment: Where ShortLynx.Core is reachable from a browser. Only used by the Social page's Threads/Reddit 'Connect' links, since those routes moved to Core's SocialOAuthController and Admin can no longer use a relative href for them. Empty is a harmless no-op — the links just point nowhere useful until this is set.
